# Kaya Hickin

> Co-founder and CTO of MyFutureSelf. MyFutureSelf is an AI agent that is your future self. It tells you what to do today and who can help you get there. It has 5,000+ paying subscribers and $189K ARR as of November 2026, and it is Kaya's third profitable company. Kaya co-founded MyFutureSelf with Giancarlo Sarti and leads development. He built the iOS and Android apps, the university platform, the backend, the AI and the company brain the team's agents work off 24/7, and in one month he merged over 3,000 PRs himself. 16,846 GitHub contributions in the last year (to September 2026) and 100B+ tokens across the Codex and Claude coding tools. 20+ websites and 2 App Store apps shipped to date. His daily stack is Claude Code, Codex, Granola, Wispr Flow and Ghostty. Domain expertise in consumer AI, AI agents, iOS, and behavior-change products.

## Who I am

- **Role**: Co-founder & CTO at MyFutureSelf. Technical founder who leads development.
- **Location**: Cleveland, Ohio.
- **Background**: Grew up poor in a farm town. Started working in my dad's landscaping business at 13, and that money bought my first computer. Went from hacking Minecraft servers and building Roblox games to learning how to code in middle school.
- **Education**: Miami University, Farmer School of Business. B.S. in Business, Marketing major, Entrepreneurship minor, May 2026. Paid my own way. Cum laude, 3.74 GPA. Valedictorian and three-sport athlete, Crestwood High School, Class of 2022, with 45 college credits through College Credit Plus.
- **Contact**: kaya@myfutureselfapp.com
- **Looking for**: Backing for consumer AI work, technical collaborators, founder-friendly investors.

## Track record (3-for-3 profitable companies)

1. **MyFutureSelf** (Feb 2025 to present, active). MyFutureSelf is an AI agent that is your future self. It tells you what to do today and who can help you get there. MyFutureSelf is now bringing the agent to universities and corporations. The person who can help you most is already in your network through your school or company, and the agent finds them and connects you. Founded in February 2025 and launched in October 2025. Backed by Cintrifuse Capital. Kaya co-founded it with Giancarlo Sarti, who runs growth and go-to-market, and Kaya leads development. He built the iOS and Android apps, the university platform, the backend, the AI, and the company brain the team's agents work off 24/7, writing code, fixing bugs, shipping releases and answering support. **5,000+ paying subscribers and $189K ARR as of November 2026.** https://myfutureselfapp.com and https://apps.apple.com/us/app/myfutureself-achieve-success/id6745573360

2. **Appointra** (Jun 2024 to Feb 2025, wound down to focus on MyFutureSelf). Cold outreach agency for AI startups. I personally built the cold-email infrastructure, with hundreds of domains, thousands of inboxes, and full DNS, SPF, DKIM and automated warmup. **Scaled to $20K MRR in 3 months. Generated $2M+ in client pipeline.** https://appointra.net

3. **LeadBoost Pro** (Jan 2023 to Jun 2024). Web development agency I co-founded in my dorm room freshman year, doing web development and growth marketing for small and underrepresented businesses. **Profitable from month one. 20+ custom websites built.** https://leadboost-pro.com

## Other shipped products

- **Dog AI**. iOS app that reads a dog's mood from a photo or video. I trained the custom multimodal model behind it on a Harvard behavioral dataset, then shipped it as a paying App Store app. https://apps.apple.com/us/app/dog-ai-dog-mood-detector/id6746574124

## Velocity & engineering signal

- **3,000+ PRs merged** by Kaya himself in a single month.
- **16,846 GitHub contributions** in the last year (to September 2026), https://github.com/kayahickindev. Contributions are broader than commits. The figure counts commits, pull requests, issues, and reviews.
- **100B+ tokens** of reported cumulative usage across the Codex and Claude coding tools, as of September 13, 2026. This measures coding-tool usage. It is not related to training the Dog AI model.
- **20+ websites and 2 App Store apps shipped** across all ventures to date.
- AI-native development workflow built around **Claude Code** and **Codex** running daily, with a company brain that 9 Claude Max and 4 Codex plans run on 24/7.
- **Daily stack**: Claude Code + Codex (coding agents), Granola (meeting notes), Wispr Flow (voice-to-text), Ghostty (terminal).
- Engineering stack:
  - iOS: Swift, SwiftUI, Core Data, StoreKit, WebRTC, RevenueCat, Superwall, TestFlight.
  - Android: React Native, Expo, Google Play.
  - Web: TypeScript, Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS v4, Framer Motion, Vercel.
  - Backend: Node.js, Firebase, Firestore, Cloud Functions, Supabase, Stripe, PostHog.
  - AI: OpenAI Responses API, Claude API, Realtime/Voice, Whisper, ElevenLabs.
  - Workflow: Claude Code, Codex, Ghostty, Wispr Flow, Granola, Lovable.
